svg.text: Recurrence in neural networks: what repeats, and along which axis
Each panel is the computation unrolled. A fill pattern marks one weight set — same pattern, same weights.

g.text: C queries world model M in latent vectors
solves for the fixed point directly
no gradient except the last pass
Ho et al. 2020; Lipman et al. 2023
one network re-run per denoising step
same update repeated to a stored pattern
input clamped, iterated to a fixed point
tied within a stage, not between
Geiping et al. 2025; Giannou et al. 2023
SE-RRM: Freinschlag et al. 2026, 2 M params

svg.text: Identical fill = identical weights: the same layer drawn again. A dashed purple frame marks a whole architecture that repeats. A solid arrow marks the output returning as input.
